title: Typed uncurried fixed-scalar complex tensor pullback
statement: For an additive monoidal left adjoint L between braided monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian categories, construct the signed-total tensor comparison as an uncurried natural transformation, using mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans on the ordinary oplax tensor map. Its component on P,Q is exactly the published mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans component. Specialize this construction to ordinary fixed-scalar pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. No flatness or derived category is used. The statement uses the identity-component uncurrying conversion [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-complex].

source.place: Tag 07A4, signed total of the ordinary tensor comparison

proof.text: Compose the identity-component uncurrying/postcomposition isomorphism with the uncurrying of mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans for the ordinary tensor comparison. Its source and target are explicitly the two signed-total tensor functors, so the construction avoids unfolding the entire native complex monoidal category after concrete specialization.

The published component formulas for mapBifunctorComparisonNatTrans and mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans identify the two chain maps. Prove this with abstract coefficient categories, then specialize the construction to the fixed-scalar inverse image; use the generic component equation directly when needed.

lean.statement:
def finiteScalarComplexTensorPullbackForFunctor
    {C D : Type*} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Category.{u + 1} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalPreadditive D]
    [MonoidalClosed C] [MonoidalClosed D] [BraidedCategory C] [BraidedCategory D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [L.IsLeftAdjoint] [L.Monoidal] :
    finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor C ⋙
        L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⟶
      ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        finiteScalarRepresentativeTotalTensor D
